Congress to Oppose FCRA Amendment Bill, Cites Foreign Funding Concerns

Congress leader Mallikarjun Kharge announced that the party will strongly oppose the Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Act (FCRA) amendment bill. The opposition is gearing up to resist the bill, raising concerns about its implications for foreign funding.
